name: When should I engage a construction company for a new apartment building project?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a construction company for a new apartment building project?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to engage a construction company or general contractor early in the project lifecycle, ideally during the design development phase, sometimes referred to as pre-construction. This early involvement allows the contractor to provide valuable input on constructability, cost-effectiveness of design choices, material selection, and accurate project scheduling. Their expertise can help identify potential issues before they become costly problems during actual construction. Early engagement ensures a smoother transition from design to groundbreaking and helps optimize the overall project outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a construction company early, during the design development phase, for input on constructability, cost, and scheduling to optimize the project.
